deck_title: Euler P_cr = pi^2*EI/L_eff^2 critical column buckling law vs naive length-invariant compressive crushing rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Leonhard Euler (1744, De curvis elasticis; 1759, Sur la force des colonnes) elastic column buckling law (critical load P_cr = pi^2 * E * I / L_eff^2 = P_cr0 / (1 + u) scaling inversely with squared effective buckling length (L_eff / L_0)^2 = 1 + u, locking P_active / P_Euler = 1.0000x across all 17 slenderness stations u in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive length-invariant compressive crushing threshold (P = P_cr0, which overestimates the critical buckling load by (L_eff / L_0)^2 = 1 + u to 1.2500x at S4, 1.5000x at S8, and 2.0000x at S16 across 16/17 stations) and 64-slice Rayleigh-Timoshenko sinusoidal bending energy quotient quadrature.

Triggering smooth sinusoidal half-wave elastica deflection w(z) = w_max * sin(pi * z / L_eff) as soon as axial load exceeds P_cr
